method: same as tools/playtest/juice-stress.mjs: 60 projectiles/frame via the game's own fireWeapon(clone=true) + one death burst/flash per frame, right key held. idle = 600ms settle, no held key, no injected load. loaded = 1200ms warm-up + 5000ms of the described load, read from the 180-frame window.HB.perf() ring.
caveat: headless Chrome, one machine, one run per reading — evidence about this code's per-frame work, not a claim about any particular device. rAF is vsync-locked (120Hz here), so fps cannot exceed the panel rate; avgMs/worstMs/over20ms are the load-bearing fields.
